meta.reportTitle: Q3 review · AI Smart Replenishment Suggestions
meta.projectStage: Go / no-go review · revisit in two weeks
meta.subtitle: Fictional material for a biz-retro-analyzer demo. The company, people, and numbers are invented.
meta.lead: What Zhou called in the room was a time-boxed evaluation: alerts first, a light demo for replenishment, look again in two weeks. The follow-up group message rewrote that as “replenishment confirmed as a Q3 priority, alerts after the demo.” Both premises for replenishment — data coverage and what customers actually asked for — were contradicted in the meeting.
meta.noiseNote: 05:05-06:40 room-booking / screen drop and 14:00-14:50 small talk were isolated. 10:15 contains “dinner”; that line is kept because it is evidence.
